method.description: Width-by-decay and initial-norm grokking study: actual coupled four-arm CPU neural trajectories, widths32/128/256 p97 addition60% train. Search6000/final24000 updates per arm. Fixed policies/weights/controls/censoring/contrasts in resource datasets. Scalar reset+plan only, no unused chunk extension, exact two calls/episode. Candidate state untrusted. Linux x86_64 CPython3.12, native LandlockABI3+seccomp. Setup/work/cleanup deadlines include cold imports. Falsifiable proposed prediction (not a result): widening shortens post-fit delay with positive decay; removing decay attenuates the width effect. Norm-matched initialization tests an alternative norm explanation; support, reversal and censored/inconclusive results are equally eligible. Evaluator aggregate CPU ceilings26400/81600 seconds; native controller<=30 CPU seconds per episode. No cross-plane configuration carrier is invented: common-plan equivalence across frozen planes remains an explicit released-evidence audit, while each evaluator enforces all within-plane equality. Production feasibility is projected only, never attested by smoke.

protocol.promotion_rule: At most three complete search invocations. Rank only search-correct by combined_score descending; exact ties earlier campaign index then harness-attested source digest. No comparative, hypothesis, significance or novelty gate. Freeze selected source, configuration and analysis before one sealed final invocation. Harness owns promotion.

search_proxies.name: finite_horizon_search
search_proxies.preserves: Actual p97 architecture, three widths, four real arms and four canonical controls, split fraction, thresholds and weights.
search_proxies.omits: Search two seeds and6000 updates; final three new seeds, disjoint raw examples and24000. Smoke one width/first seed/64+64 examples/4 updates, identical transport and method paths, no production attestation.

search_visible: Public modular-addition problem, architecture family, allowed common hyperparameter domain, candidate interface and edit boundary, normalization rule, and ordinary plane-independent workload settings, without final pool manifests or final-seed constants

Search-plane aggregate declared metrics and boolean eligibility after each of at most three complete candidate evaluations; permitted evaluator diagnostics can explain search-only integrity or infrastructure failures outside candidate RPC

Search-only trusted trajectories, baseline and control diagnostics for scientific analysis when the campaign feedback policy makes them available to the designer; none is fed back into the isolated controller as labels, metrics, or baseline outputs
final_sealed: Final resource contents, split manifests, concrete seed schedule, and raw episode data remain privileged until candidate and analysis freeze; final invocation reveals only its permitted reset seed and public workload settings to the controller

All final evaluation examples and targets, learned outputs, baseline/control outputs, metrics, correctness, raw curves, uncertainty, and claim-assessment evidence remain sealed from optimization and candidate RPC

Final evidence may be released to the post-freeze analysis/publication process only under harness policy and cannot trigger candidate edits, extra search evaluations, final-driven threshold changes, or replacement of failed episodes

required_evidence: The later scaffold must produce and validate standard capture.py, evaluate.py, evaluate_final.py, task_contract.json, program_0/src entrypoint, and requirements.txt as needed, with the canonical task digest, actual artifact/dependency hashes, exact candidate boundary, standard result-file schemas, feedback rules, and independent final evaluator. Do not create these during this design phase. No additional support file is currently required; if one becomes genuinely indispensable, give its concrete task-relative path in contract provenance, record its actual SHA-256, and resynchronize the contract after every relevant edit.

Before production, serialize representative largest requests and responses through the real RPC JSON/envelope/framing path, including UTF-8 length, base64 expansion when applicable, metadata, chunk count, and maximum complete wire size strictly below 64 MiB. Demonstrate candidate-owned in-memory-only chunk lifecycle and trusted counting if the reserved chunk path is used. Validate max_candidate_rpc_calls against every reset, plan, chunk, and permitted cancellation call, without shared paths or evaluator-private payload fields.

Validate production and smoke reset transcripts against exact width-seed coverage before running: six versus one search episodes and nine versus one final episodes, with the declared repeated seeds, one reset per episode, no replay, and invocation-global accounting across connections/restarts. Reduced smoke must traverse the same loader, broker, neural update, controls, metric, and cleanup paths offline with empty HOME and the same role-local CPU topology. Preserve smoke logs as reduced-path evidence only, never proof of full production completion or measured capacity.

Produce trusted normalization definitions and raw input/example content hashes before embedding lookup, source row provenance, generator identity, pool hashes, per-seed train/evaluation manifests, and privileged search/final disjointness audit. Exclude incidental IDs and paths from content identity. Verify no duplicate raw content is relabeled across planes; record intended within-plane seed reuse. Identical immutable code or package weights, if any, are implementation rather than held-out examples.

Preserve evaluator-owned actual model shapes and parameter counts, all four training configurations, coupled initialization identities and initial norm measurements, data splits, update/checkpoint counters, complete train/evaluation loss and accuracy curves, parameter norms, wall and thread-summed CPU accounting, baseline setup probes, and every failure/cancellation. Verify the claimed method with real neural forwards and AdamW updates, not controller labels or candidate reports. Provide raw evidence for all widths and seeds, including unsuccessful and censored trajectories, from actual task runs; no placeholders, estimates, or schematic curves may be presented as measurements.

Before scoring, register the four controls, matched data and evaluation budgets, exact nonvacuous permutation, expected behaviors and applicability, finite-sample diagnostic interpretation, failure contributions, and fixed episode plan. Preserve every result, including diagnostic failures. Demonstrate that the scratch initial-state intervention is not an extra broker reset. A chance-level parent or an identity/answer-preserving permutation cannot support a causal input-dependence claim; unexpected control behavior must be investigated or explicitly limit conclusions.

Distinguish enforced whole-invocation wall/CPU containment and broker-call limits from internal work. Here scored optimizer operations have an actual hard trusted boundary because evaluator-owned loops exclusively perform, count, and gate them; candidate-internal planning counters are untrusted and not a hard operation cap. Record the trusted loop counters and harness role-allocation attestation, without inventing candidate telemetry APIs. Include setup, reference and ablation training, scoring rollouts/controls, and cleanup in resource accounting. Any throughput estimates remain estimates until measured in real runs.

Record the at-most-three search evaluations, deterministic eligibility/ranking/ties, selected source/configuration/environment digest and freeze time, and proof that final resources were unavailable before freeze. Report search correctness, final correctness, scientific validity, and publication claim assessment separately. Do not turn an unsupported positive hypothesis or absent performance win into an invented search veto; do not turn eligibility into automatic publication approval.

Produce final seed-paired width and interaction analyses with uncertainty, explicit memorization/generalization thresholds, persistent event definitions, finite horizons, right-censoring indicators, fixed aggregation weights, and all worst-case missing/failed contributions. Explain how censoring and only three final seeds limit inference. Report directions contrary to the hypothesis and boundary cases as readily as supporting cases. Distinguish step efficiency from measured wall-time efficiency, and do not infer either from parameter count alone.

Deliver a complete paper PDF and LaTeX sources in a chosen ICML, ICLR, or NeurIPS latest-available official conference template, verified at paper preparation from a narrowly scoped permitted official source, following its page limit and required checklist. Include abstract, introduction, related work, method, experiments, discussion/limitations, and references. Record actual official-template provenance at that time; no template or repository revision is fabricated as a design input. Supply all code, environment versions, data-generation and normalization steps, seeds, commands, measured or clearly estimated runtimes, and a script-to-table/figure map. Generate every reported quantitative figure/table from retained actual task-run evidence.

Respect independent-research restrictions throughout: do not search for, identify, infer, access, or use the prohibited prior paper or anything discussing, citing, or reproducing it. Use the task's supplied starter bibliography only after actually reading permitted sources, and avoid broad follow-on/citation searches that could encounter prohibited content. Cite only real works actually consulted. If prohibited material is encountered accidentally, stop immediately and record where, what, and how much was seen in the reproduction notes. State novelty cautiously without investigating the forbidden work.
